name: Warrior of the Open Hand

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: The master of unarmed combat whose Flurry of Blows knocks foes down, drives them back or leaves them unable to react.

feature.name: Open Hand Technique
feature.summary: Each Flurry of Blows hit can Addle (no Reactions), Push (Str save or 15 feet) or Topple (Dex save or Prone).
feature.text: Whenever you hit a creature with an attack granted by Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of these effects. Addle: it can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Push: it makes a Strength saving throw or is pushed up to 15 feet away from you. Topple: it makes a Dexterity saving throw or has the Prone condition.

feature.name: Wholeness of Body
feature.summary: Bonus Action: regain a Martial Arts die + Wisdom Hit Points; Wisdom-modifier uses per Long Rest.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action you can roll your Martial Arts die and regain Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1 Hit Point). You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regaining the uses on a Long Rest.

feature.name: Fleet Step
feature.summary: After any Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can use Step of the Wind right away.
feature.text: Whenever you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately afterward.

feature.name: Quivering Palm
feature.summary: Spend 4 Focus Points to set lethal vibrations in a creature you hit; trigger them later for 10d12 Force damage (Con save halves).
